notes: Embassy, Washington consular section, four Consulates General, and official honorary-consulate listings seeded from gov.pl.

First-pass national roster seeded from current ORPEG/gov.pl and Polish Supplementary School Council of America listings.
91 established Polish schools or structured Polish supplementary-education programs are now represented across major Polonia regions.
Smaller preschool/daycare-only entries and weak/stale listings were deliberately excluded.
This is a living directory: ORPEG records and school contact/enrollment details should be periodically refreshed, and newly established schools can be added without redesigning the schema.
First-pass national roster of active Polish-language parishes, missions and durable Polish pastoral communities is mature.
Coverage emphasizes current Polish ministry rather than historic Polish identity alone, and includes Roman Catholic and Polish National Catholic communities where relevant.
Polish Mass/confession schedules are intentionally not hard-coded because they change frequently; Hanka should route users to the official parish/diocesan source for current times.

The directory is designed for periodic refresh as ministries open, merge, relocate or change language schedules; occasional isolated Polish services can be added later when they materially improve local coverage.

First-pass national institutional roster is mature, seeded primarily from the Embassy of the Republic of Poland's current list of Polish institutions operating in the United States and official organization sources.
Includes national and regional civic organizations, cultural centers, museums/libraries, educational/scientific institutions, youth/scouting groups, arts organizations and professional associations.
Informal social-media-only groups and very small ad-hoc clubs are excluded from the canonical first pass; durable new institutions can be added later.
Organizational status, programs and contact details are freshness-sensitive and should be periodically refreshed independently of the factual Brain.

Commercial/professional directory now contains 103 Polish-focused food/retail physical locations, with increasingly deep coverage in Chicagoland, NY/NJ, Connecticut and the Northeast plus a broad national seed.

New York coverage now includes Greenpoint/Ridgewood as well as upstate Polish-food anchors around Buffalo/Niagara and the Capital Region; New Britain CT and New Jersey have neighborhood-level clusters represented.

Chains and multi-location businesses are stored per physical location to support future geographic/near-me retrieval. Commercial status, addresses, hours and services remain high-churn and require periodic refresh.
Food/retail remains started rather than mature: additional PA/MA/New England, Midwest, Florida and other metro depth is still warranted before moving to professional-service directories.
